window_rule: [event - 120 s, event + 120 s]; event = the local flatten readback instant, recovered by solving for the offset at which the v1 income pull reproduces the published cost table
symbol_rule: symbols carrying a COMMISSION row inside the window (a symbol trading without a commission row would be missed - a stated boundary)
boundary: the +/-120 s window is an attribution choice, not a venue event grouping; regular non-flatten trades inside it are included

cross_instrument_reconciliation.what: two INDEPENDENT venue endpoints on the same window: /fapi/v1/income REALIZED_PNL rows vs /fapi/v1/userTrades realizedPnl. Neither derives from the other.
cross_instrument_reconciliation.verdict: six of eight buckets agree to the LAST DECIMAL PLACE. The two that differ: 08-05 00:17:41 (4 income commission rows with no userTrade in the window, +0.1415 USDT) and two buckets differing by under a thousandth of a USDT. Total difference 0.1406 USDT on -2,275.31, i.e. 0.006 percent. This CORROBORATES the +/-120 s attribution rule across two instruments that share no code path; it does NOT make the window a venue-supplied event grouping.
cross_instrument_reconciliation.named_gap: 08-05 00:17:41: 247 income COMMISSION rows vs 243 userTrades in the same window. Four rows are unexplained. A commission row whose trade timestamp falls just outside the window is the likely reading, but that is a HYPOTHESIS, not a measurement - it is named here rather than smoothed.

measured_facts.what_that_means: every one of the 4,804 protective-flatten fills was a TAKER. Not one maker fill in any bucket. So the flatten cost carries the full taker fee plus the spread crossing on 100 percent of the volume - previously an assumption, now measured.
measured_facts.prior_nominal_claim: the earlier registered figure for these eight buckets was a nominal of about 269k USD; the fill-level gross traded is 253,986 USDT.
